summary: Completed backend+frontend validation for free-model fallback scope. Updated stale unit contracts to current helper boundaries, added deterministic fallback/catalogue test suite, verified live preview chat fallback/persistence, responsive behavior, production build, and health/core smoke without DB dependency.

ui_bugs.issue: Core calculator keys (notably operator/enter) do not expose stable data-testid/accessible names, causing brittle automation selectors.

action_items: Optional testability hardening: add stable data-testid/ARIA labels to calculator operator and enter controls.
No fallback/backend functional blocker detected in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: Fallback engine now test-covered for 5-attempt cap, stop/retry policy matrix, Retry-After handling, and strict zero-cost provider caps on every attempt.
Catalogue parser is validated against duplicate IDs, optional request pricing omission, modality filters, and rejection of nonzero/malformed pricing.
Live preview confirms browser-only storage contract (`database_required:false`) and successful real free-model multi-turn continuity with session isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deterministic fallback/exhaustion/model-alias UI checks were executed with explicit Playwright route fixtures (not production behavior) plus separate real preview calls. Live run observed fallback switch from selected model to inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-fin:free with attempts rendered and IndexedDB persistence across reload.
rca of the issue: Primary defect during this run was stale unit-contract wiring: tests patched `chat.httpx` and expected obsolete `max_completion_tokens`. Current implementation moved HTTP calls into `free_fallback.complete_free` and uses `max_tokens`. Updating tests to patch `free_fallback.httpx` and assert current payload contract resolved failures.
